name: Supervisor Sato!
source: SupervisorSato! is a Kinetic Visual Novel which tells the story of Saori Sato, a Japanese Highschool student who gets hired as the new Supervisor for Sayama Highschool, an Elite Girl-Only school, known for its secrets and mysteries
